subject: Marius pairs: lopsidedness labels, nothing dropped
body: All 456 Marius time-split pairs (373 pre-T, 83 post-T) judged by the blind Haiku gate (693b763). Labels in data/researchers/marius_hobbhahn/agreement.jsonl: lopsided (either way; history 331, held-out 73) and the weaker lopsided_his (judge picks his option; history 239, held-out 27). Per Ethan, no pair is deleted: track_eval.load_choices prints both counts on every load. Before E2/select/final, decide whether to filter and on which field. Weak gate keeps 56 held-out pairs from 12 docs (floor 40/10). Note: the E2_S prereg predates this.
